strategies.name: 横截面多因子 Top-2
strategies.description: 结合20日动量与30日波动率排序，选择得分前两名等权持有。未使用价值、质量等财务因子。
strategies.requirements: 建议至少3只资产，每只60个交易日
strategies.theory: 动量 + 低波动率排序
strategies.code:
import statistics

def signals(history):
    factors = []
    for ticker, bars in history.items():
        close = [x["close"] for x in bars]
        if len(close) < 61:
            continue
        returns = [close[i] / close[i-1] - 1 for i in range(len(close)-30, len(close))]
        vol = statistics.pstdev(returns)
        mom = close[-1] / close[-21] - 1
        score = mom - 0.4 * vol
        factors.append((score, ticker))
    picks = [ticker for _, ticker in sorted(factors, reverse=True)[:2]]
    return {ticker: 1.0 / len(picks) for ticker in picks} if picks else {}
strategies.note: 仅用于展示横截面排序。真实多因子选股还需PIT财报、行业中性化、风险暴露与交易成本控制。
